value.rationale: The first central modular truncation beyond the p-dimensional quotient changes the commuting-pair population by a nontrivial constant factor and has a non-split Lie extension. The full centralizer-rank census for every p and q controls natural Lie invariants and reveals a characteristic-dependent resonance. Unlike a small isolated recomputation, the result supplies a uniform structural explanation and a quantitative comparison with split central extensions.
